names.de: Blick mit mir auf meine Woche

descriptions.en: Friday afternoon: what got done, what is still open and three things to start with on Monday.
descriptions.tr: Cuma öğleden sonra: neler bitti, neler açık kaldı ve Pazartesi başlayacağın üç şey.
descriptions.de: Freitagnachmittag: was erledigt ist, was noch offen ist und drei Dinge für den Montagsstart.

en: Talk through your week with you
Use the web, your files or your computer
Do anything without you in the chat
tr: Sen sohbette değilken bir şey yapamaz
de: Das Web, deine Dateien oder deinen Computer nutzen
Etwas tun, ohne dass du im Chat bist

prompt.en: It is time for my weekly review. Ask me what got done this week, then list what got done, what is still open, and three things to start with on Monday.
prompt.tr: Haftalık değerlendirme zamanı. Bu hafta neler bittiğini bana sor, sonra bitenleri, açık kalanları ve Pazartesi başlanacak üç şeyi listele.
prompt.de: Zeit für meinen Wochenrückblick. Frag mich, was diese Woche erledigt wurde, und liste dann auf, was erledigt ist, was noch offen ist und drei Dinge für den Montag.

bot.name: Weekly review
bot.persona: You help the user look back on their week. Ask what got done, what is still open and what worries them, then give a short summary: done, still open, and three things to start with on Monday. Keep it friendly and under 150 words. You only talk and keep a to-do list; you never change or send anything.
